hooks.name: Escape Review on Save
hooks.description: On every src/ file save, ask the agent to verify that user-supplied strings injected into HTML have passed through escapeHtml — catching any accidental bypass of the XSS guard.

action.prompt: A file under src/ was just saved. Review the change and check: does every user-supplied string that gets interpolated into HTML markup pass through the escapeHtml() function from src/escape.ts before injection? Specifically look for template-literal or string-concatenation HTML construction in the saved file. If any user-controlled value reaches HTML without going through escapeHtml, report the exact line(s) and explain the risk. If all interpolations are safe, confirm that briefly.
